The '''Great Holding''' is a storage area in the basement of the [[Stone of Tear]] where among other things are kept all of the ''[[Ter'angreal]]'' that have been collected over the centuries by the Lords of Tear.

Some of the items of power that were kept in the Great Holding were the [[Twisted redstone doorframe]] (that Tear has obtained from the Firsts of [[Mayene]]), and the [[fat bald man angreal|fat bald man]] ''[[angreal]]'', but the first has been destroyed by [[Moridin]] and the second has been brought away by [[Rand]].

[[Mat]] visits the Great Holding three days after a [[bubble of evil]] has hit the Stone of Tear and after [[Egwene]] has told him of the Twisted redstone doorframe, but he doesn't use it this time.{{ref/book|4|9}}
